_help: Used only by scripts/release/syncGumroad.mjs (npm run release:gumroad), an optional owner step that is no longer part of a release (Burrow is free for everyone). It is NOT read by the app and is not baked into any build. proProductId, freeLicenseProductId and downloadProductId are the Gumroad product_id values of the three product pages the script keeps a 'Latest version:' line on (an empty value leaves that page out). Product ids are not secret. Keep this file valid JSON.
